request.query: An irrational real with infinitely many rational approximating pairs has arbitrarily large coprime denominator approximants

items.name: setOf_liouville_eq_irrational_inter_iInter_iUnion
items.type: {x | Liouville x} = {x | Irrational x} ∩ ⋂ n, ⋃ a, ⋃ b, ⋃ (_ : 1 < b), Metric.ball (↑a / ↑b) (1 / ↑b ^ n)

items.name: Liouville.frequently_exists_num
items.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, Liouville x → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ᶠ (b : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∃ a, x ≠ ↑a / ↑b ∧ |x - ↑a / ↑b| < 1 / ↑b ^ n

items.name: Rat.den_le_and_le_num_le_of_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq
items.type: ∀ {ξ q : ℚ}, |ξ - q| < 1 / ↑q.den ^ 2 → q.den ≤ ξ.den ∧ ⌈ξ * ↑q.den⌉ - 1 ≤ q.num ∧ q.num ≤ ⌊ξ * ↑q.den⌋ + 1
